description: Weakness classes in scope for the project, and the real-world CVE patterns that realise them. Sinks and sources are call-expression suffixes matched against the Tree-sitter call index.

cwes.name: OS Command Injection
cwes.summary: Attacker-controlled data reaches a shell command interpreter, so the data is parsed as a command rather than as an argument.

cwes.name: Code Injection
cwes.summary: Untrusted data is evaluated as program text, giving the attacker arbitrary execution inside the process.

cwes.name: Server-Side Template Injection
cwes.summary: A template is compiled from a string that contains user input, so the input is evaluated inside the template sandbox.

cwes.name: SQL Injection
cwes.summary: A query string is built by concatenating or formatting user input, so the input changes the query structure.

cwes.name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
cwes.summary: A native object-construction primitive is applied to untrusted bytes, and constructing the object is enough to run attacker code.

cwes.name: Heap-based Buffer Overflow
cwes.summary: A copy writes past the end of a heap allocation whose size is not derived from the copy length.

cwes.name: Classic Buffer Copy Overflow
cwes.summary: An unbounded copy writes into a fixed-size buffer, overflowing it when the source is longer than the destination.

cwes.name: Out-of-bounds Write
cwes.summary: A write lands outside the bounds of the intended buffer.

cwes.name: Integer Overflow
cwes.summary: An arithmetic result wraps around, so a size, index or length computed from it is smaller than the data it describes.

cwes.name: Integer Underflow
cwes.summary: An arithmetic result wraps below zero, so a length or bound becomes invalid.

cwes.name: Path Traversal
cwes.summary: A path is built from user input without constraining it to an intended directory.

cwes.name: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference
cwes.summary: An XML parser resolves external entities, so a document can reference local files or network resources.

cwes.name: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
cwes.summary: A weak or broken algorithm protects data that the design assumes to be confidential.

cwes.name: Use of Insufficiently Random Values
cwes.summary: A predictable value is used where an attacker must not be able to guess or reproduce it.

cwes.name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
cwes.summary: A credential is embedded in the source, so it is disclosed to anyone who can read the code or the binary.

cwes.name: Use of Externally-Controlled Format String
cwes.summary: A format string comes from user input, so conversion directives in the input are interpreted by the callee.

cves.title: Sudo heap-based buffer overflow (Baron Samedit): an off-by-one in the argument parsing of sudoedit lets a trailing backslash overflow the heap buffer, escalating to root
Integer overflow in the ngx_chain_get_file_buf / range filter of the HTTP range processing allows an out-of-bounds read and, on some builds, a write
cves.weakness_source: root cause recorded; impact is an out-of-bounds read

cves.project: Trend Micro Apex One / OfficeScan XG / Worry-Free Business Security
cves.title: Improper access control in Trend Micro Apex One (on-prem), OfficeScan XG SP1 and Worry-Free Business Security 10.0 SP1 reveals information about x86 agent hotfixes
cves.out_of_scope_reason: Named in the proposal as a template-injection example, but it is an information-disclosure issue in a closed-source endpoint security product. NVD records NVD-CWE-Other. It has no static source-to-sink pattern in the languages under study, so it is not used as a class example; CVE-2025-27516 covers the same CWE-1336 class.

cves.title: PIL.ImageMath.eval in Pillow before 9.0.0 evaluates arbitrary Python expressions supplied to it, allowing code execution
cves.weakness_source: Snyk CWE-94; GitHub Advisory CWE-74; Red Hat CWE-77

cves.title: Jinja before 3.1.6: the interaction between the sandboxed environment and the |attr filter lets an attacker who controls template content execute arbitrary Python code, a server-side template injection
cves.weakness_source: IBM security bulletin CWE-1336; NVD CVSS 8.8

notes: CVE identifiers were checked against NVD rather than recalled. CVE-2021-3156 is a heap-based buffer overflow (CWE-122/CWE-193), not command injection; CVE-2021-25239 is a Trend Micro information-disclosure issue, not template injection, and is retained only as an out-of-scope record. CVE-2025-27516 is the CWE-1336 example.
